findings.title: Async forEach delays calendar deletions until after apiDeletes is awaited
findings.body: This async callback now awaits `getCalendar` before pushing its `deleteEvent` promises into `apiDeletes`. The surrounding function continues synchronously to `Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes))`, so `apiDeletes` is still empty when that array is evaluated. The recurring-cancellation path therefore marks bookings cancelled and returns without awaiting or observing the calendar deletions; failures become unhandled rejections and external calendar events/availability can remain stale. Use a `for...of` loop with `await` or `await Promise.all(credentials.map(async ...))` and collect the deletion promises before awaiting them.

findings.title: Async forEach drops calendar/video deletion promises during reschedule
findings.body: `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => ...)` does not await the async callback. Because `getCalendar` is now awaited inside it, the callback suspends before calling `calendar.deleteEvent`/`deleteMeeting`, so `Reschedule` can return before those integrations have run. The surrounding `try/catch` cannot catch rejections from the callback either, so calendar/video events may remain after a reschedule and errors become unhandled rejections. Use `for...of` with `await` or `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(async ...))`.

findings.title: Async forEach drops calendar/video deletion promises during reschedule
findings.body: `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => ...)` does not await the async callback. Because `getCalendar` is now awaited inside it, the callback suspends before calling `calendar.deleteEvent`/`deleteMeeting`, so `Reschedule` can return before those integrations have run. The surrounding `try/catch` cannot catch rejections from the callback either, so calendar/video events may remain after a reschedule and errors become unhandled rejections. Use `for...of` with `await` or `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(async ...))`.

findings.title: requestReschedule does not await calendar/video deletions
findings.body: `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => ...)` is not awaited. With the new `await getCalendar(...)`, the callback suspends before invoking `calendar.deleteEvent`/`deleteMeeting`, so `requestReschedule` proceeds to send the reschedule email and return while cancellations are still pending. Any rejected calendar/video deletion is also unhandled. This can leave old calendar/video events active after the user has been told the reschedule request succeeded. Await the callbacks via `for...of` or `Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(...))`.
